name: Josh Gottheimer
summary:
Joshua S. Gottheimer ( GOT-hy-mər; born March 8, 1975) is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for New Jersey's 5th congressional district since 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, Gottheimer was a speechwriter for Bill Clinton and served as an adviser to the presidential campaigns of Wesley Clark, John Kerry, and Hillary Clinton. 
Prior to running for office, Gottheimer has worked for Burson Cohn & Wolfe, the Federal Communications Commission, Ford Motor Company, and Microsoft.
